tools.name: bn_variable_list
tools.title: List Variables
tools.description: List variables for one active binary view function.

function.description: Function start address expression resolving to exactly one analyzed function. Accepts hex like 0x401000, symbols, and Binary Ninja expressions.

arch.description: Optional architecture name used to disambiguate functions that share the same start address.

offset.description: Zero-based item offset for pagination. Defaults to 0.

limit.description: Maximum items to return. Defaults to 100 and is capped at 1000.

tools.name: bn_variable_rename
tools.title: Rename Variable
tools.description: Rename a function variable.

function.description: Function start address expression resolving to exactly one analyzed function. Accepts hex like 0x401000, symbols, and Binary Ninja expressions.

arch.description: Optional architecture name used to disambiguate functions that share the same start address.

variable.description: Current variable name from bn_variable_list; this is not a variable id.

skipAnalysisUpdate.description: Do not request analysis after this variable rename. Defaults to false; use only when batching variable edits and call bn_analysis_update afterwards.

tools.name: bn_variable_set_type
tools.title: Set Variable Type
tools.description: Set a function variable type.

function.description: Function start address expression resolving to exactly one analyzed function. Accepts hex like 0x401000, symbols, and Binary Ninja expressions.

arch.description: Optional architecture name used to disambiguate functions that share the same start address.

variable.description: Current variable name from bn_variable_list; this is not a variable id.

definition.description: One C type string parsed directly as the desired variable type. Specify exactly one of definition or source.

source.description: C source snippet parsed for types, variables, and functions. Specify exactly one of source or definition.

type.description: Parsed type or variable name to select from source when the source parses to multiple candidates. Requires source.

options.description: Parser/compiler-style options passed through to Binary Ninja's type parser when source is used.

includeDirs.description: Include search directories passed to the type parser when source is used.

importDependencies.description: Whether parsed dependencies should be imported when source is used. Defaults to true.

skipAnalysisUpdate.description: Do not request analysis after this variable type change. Defaults to false; use only when batching variable edits and call bn_analysis_update afterwards.
